sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(c.client_id) * 100 AS percentage_female
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE 
    dis.A11 > 10000
